about.stat2Desc: Switch themes on the fly with zero page reload.

features.title: Liquid Glass Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build high-end, immersive digital experiences.
features.v4Title: What do you want to build?
features.v4Subtitle: Select your goal and see how Liquid Glass helps you get there faster.
features.v5CtaDesc: Start building with the complete Liquid Glass toolkit today.
features.f1Desc: Zero-JS by default architecture ensures your site loads in the blink of an eye.
features.f1LongDesc: Built on Astro 5.0's island architecture, only the JavaScript you need is shipped. This means sub-second load times and perfect Core Web Vitals scores out of the box.
features.f2Desc: Multi-layered blur and refraction effects for a truly premium aesthetic.
features.f2LongDesc: Our glassmorphism system uses carefully calibrated backdrop filters, layered transparencies, and subtle gradients to create depth without sacrificing performance.
features.f3Desc: Every component responds gracefully to any screen size or orientation.
features.f3LongDesc: Mobile-first responsive design with fluid typography, adaptive spacing, and context-aware layouts that work beautifully from watch to ultrawide.
features.f4Desc: 10+ built-in themes or create your own signature look in seconds.
features.f4LongDesc: Powered by CSS custom properties and DaisyUI, switch themes instantly or create custom palettes. Dark mode, light mode, and everything in between.

faq.a2: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. Try everything risk-free before committing.
faq.q3: What's included in the Pro plan?
faq.a3: Pro includes unlimited projects, priority support, advanced analytics, custom domains, team collaboration, and API access. Everything you need to scale.
faq.a4: Absolutely. No contracts, no hidden fees. Cancel from your account settings with one click. We also offer a 30-day money-back guarantee.
faq.a5: Yes! Our REST API gives you full programmatic access. Check out docs.example.com for authentication guides, endpoints, and code examples in multiple languages.
faq.a6: We use bank-level AES-256 encryption, SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure, and are fully GDPR compliant. Your data security is our top priority.
faq.a7: Of course! Invite unlimited team members on Pro and Enterprise plans. Set granular permissions (Admin, Editor, Viewer) for each member.
faq.q8: How do I reset my password?
faq.a8: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send a secure reset link within seconds. Link expires in 1 hour for security.
faq.a9: 50+ integrations including Slack, GitHub, Figma, Notion, Zapier, Jira, and more. New integrations added monthly.
faq.a10: Email support@example.com, use in-app chat, or schedule a call. Average response time is under 4 hours.
faq.a11: Comprehensive docs at docs.example.com with tutorials, guides, API references, and video walkthroughs.
faq.a12: Yes! Export all your data anytime in JSON, CSV, or PDF format from Settings → Data → Export.
faq.q_create_project: How do I create my first project?
faq.a_create_project: Click the 'New Project' button in your dashboard, choose a template or start from scratch, and follow the guided setup wizard. You'll be up and running in under 2 minutes.
faq.a_sys_req: We're fully web-based, so all you need is a modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge). No downloads or installations required.
faq.a_billing: We bill monthly or annually based on your plan. Annual plans save you 20%. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account settings.
faq.a_refund: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans. If you're not satisfied, contact support for a full refund—no questions asked.
faq.a_team_discount: Yes! Teams of 5+ get 15% off, and teams of 20+ get 25% off. Contact our sales team for custom enterprise pricing.
faq.q_delete_account: How do I delete my account?
faq.a_delete_account: Go to Settings → Account → Delete Account. You'll have 30 days to change your mind before data is permanently removed.
faq.a_features: Core features include project management, real-time collaboration, version control integration, deployment automation, and analytics.
faq.a_customize: Absolutely! Customize themes, layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and create custom workflows to match your team's needs.
faq.a_offline: Yes, our desktop app supports offline mode. Changes sync automatically when you're back online.
faq.a_training: Yes! Free onboarding sessions for teams, plus premium training packages for enterprise customers.
